title: 100 Percent Guides
description: A high-performance video game achievement and 100% completion guide platform. Differentiates from legacy wikis by guaranteeing verified step-by-step checklists, official Steam OpenID profile syncing, zero-dependency interactive vector SVG maps, and autonomous AI-assisted roadmap generation.
Highlights: Real-time Steam profile syncing and dynamic achievement progress tracking
Zero-dependency interactive vector SVG game maps with coordinate pin placement and bidirectional checklist sync
Autonomous AI guide generation engine powered by Gemini Multi-Model Pool router with automatic failover
Multi-tier caching architecture delivering sub-5ms response times via Redis L1 and AWS DynamoDB L2
